messages.subject: UAE & Saudi Clean Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Corver Consulting Team,

Your specialist executive-search and talent-advisory focus on clean energy leadership across the UAE and Saudi Arabia makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. My current portfolio also intersects with major solar and battery-storage investment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where clean-energy growth requires regulatory coordination, institutional trust, sustainability governance and disciplined execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
